caption: The drawing features a square, brown, wooden panel centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The panel itself contains a symmetrical carved design composed of a circular raised boss in the center, surrounded by a square and four pointed shapes radiating outward. Each of the four corners of the square contains a diagonal branch with three rounded, bud-like elements attached, making a total of twelve buds. The surface within the square is shaded in various tones of brown to depict the texture and depth of the carved wood, with the darkest areas accentuating the central boss and corners. A thin border outlines the square panel, and all elements are rendered in naturalistic hues of wood brown, with highlights and shadows providing a sense of three-dimensional carving. There are no other objects or decorations on the drawing outside the central panel and the background remains featureless, save for a small handwritten label at the bottom right corner.
title: Mantel Carving
